title: World Bloom — All Ways Jump! With You — Episode8 The "Me" They Expect

meta.Event Outline: Just when MORE MORE JUMP! has settled in to their lives as Lumina Grand Prix contestants, they notice something wrong with the tree in their SEKAI. Before they know it, the girls find themselves in a world where the four of them never met.

rows.Speaker: Movie
rows.Line: link2_idol_op4
Photography Studio

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line:
Okay, we got some really good expressions out of you!
Nice work, Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Photographer
rows.Line:
Your aura was on full display again today!
The cover's going to look fantastic.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Thank you very much.
I look forward to working with you again.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. I managed to play it again today...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (The role of “Shizuku Hinomori”...)
A few hours later
Shizuku's Room

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Let's see... Open this app, press the home button, and...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, I can see it now.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Thank goodness. The pictures I took at that cafe I went to the other day actually went up.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I really can't thank my manager enough for running my account.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (While I'm here, I should actually check the text in the post. Let's see... “I decided to include a cardigan with my outfit since it was a little chilly. It's a little short, so I tried pairing it with some high-waisted pants.”)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (“I like this combination since the white and Saxe blue make for a crisp, grown-up look. Please give it a try yourself sometime.”)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (“I took this second picture at one my favorite cafes. I had some herbal tea while reading this book of poems that I adore.”)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (In the version I sent to my manager, I told everyone about that story I love so much...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But I suppose fantasy novels don't suit my persona...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Did I cause them trouble again...?
I need to be more careful.)

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<You look beautiful again today...>
<I'm gonna study hard to learn how to put together outfits like yours, Shizuku!>
<I might also try reading a book of poems.>

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku, the bath's ready. Do you wanna go now?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Shii...!
Thank you for coming over to tell me.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
But I'll wait until a little later.
I was just about to study some fashion.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Study? Are you gonna read through all these magazines...? I'm seeing like ten at least...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, I'd like to brush up on the latest trends.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Some people have been saying how they've been using my outfits as reference, so I need to continue doing my best to keep them happy.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I see...

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, are you sure you're okay?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: I mean, it seems like you haven't had much rest for a while.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you showing me so much concern, Shii.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: But everyone wants me to be “the perfect Shizuku Hinomori”.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, I need to do my research and stay up to date.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Still, do you really need to push yourself this hard?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes. When I returned to being a model, I swore to never again run from my duties and the expectations placed on me.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (When I quit being an idol, it looked like I was running away... I ended up disappointing so many people as a result.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But a part of me still wanted to spread hope to others...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (As fortune would have it, I was given a chance to do that as a model.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I have to fulfill my duties this time around.)

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line:
Okay...
But don't go overboard, alright?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Thank you. I won't.

rows.Speaker: Shiho
rows.Line: Anyway, I'll be taking my bath first...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course. Please take your time.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Shii's such a nice girl.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (I feel bad about making her worry about me like this...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (But the real me just isn't able to bring hope to anyone.)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: (Which means I have to keep playing the person that everybody wants me to be.)
